description:
List GE items within one numeric category. Use list_wiki_category_members for Wiki Category: titles, lookup_item for names, or get_item_details for individual records.

- Discover IDs with get_ge_info view=categories and nonempty letters with view=category_counts. IDs 0 and 42 both say Miscellaneous but identify separate groups.
- {"category":24,"alpha":"#","page":2} selects the second numeric-name page of high-level melee weapons. Pass literal #, not %23; the server encodes it.
- Restart page at 1 when category or alpha changes. Stop on empty items; isError signals failure rather than completion.
- Jagex total counts the category, not the letter. Guide prices lag activity.
- Each call makes one uncached Jagex read without credentials. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; wait for Retry-After after 429.

alpha.description: Starting letter (a-z) or # for numbers. Defaults to "a".

name: browse_items
title: Browse Catalogue Items
